name: Portal3D
description: Real-time perspective-matched visual portals and seamless physical/momentum teleportation inspired by Valve's Portal series.
shortDescription: Valve-style visual and physical portals in 3D.
author: Twillion

behaviors.name: Portal3D
behaviors.description: Turns a 3D Box face or surface into an interactive visual portal linked to another portal.

propertyDescriptors.name: Tag
propertyDescriptors.label: Portal tag (ID)
propertyDescriptors.description: Unique tag identifying this portal (e.g. Blue, Orange, PortalA)

propertyDescriptors.name: LinkedTag
propertyDescriptors.label: Linked portal tag
propertyDescriptors.description: Tag of the destination portal this portal connects to

propertyDescriptors.name: Face
propertyDescriptors.label: Face
propertyDescriptors.description: Face of the 3D Box used as the portal opening

propertyDescriptors.name: Shape
propertyDescriptors.label: Portal frame shape
propertyDescriptors.description: Visual frame style: Oval aperture ring or Rectangular box frame

propertyDescriptors.name: BorderColor
propertyDescriptors.label: Border ring color
propertyDescriptors.description: Color of the energetic portal rim glow (e.g. #00a2ff for Blue, #ff7700 for Orange)

propertyDescriptors.name: BorderWidth
propertyDescriptors.label: Border ring thickness
propertyDescriptors.description: Relative thickness of the border ring (0.01 to 0.3)

propertyDescriptors.name: Resolution
propertyDescriptors.label: Resolution
propertyDescriptors.description: Resolution preset for the offscreen portal render target

propertyDescriptors.name: CustomWidth
propertyDescriptors.label: Custom width
propertyDescriptors.description: Target texture width when Resolution is Custom

propertyDescriptors.name: CustomHeight
propertyDescriptors.label: Custom height
propertyDescriptors.description: Target texture height when Resolution is Custom

propertyDescriptors.name: ObliqueClipping
propertyDescriptors.label: Oblique near-plane clipping
propertyDescriptors.description: When enabled, modifies projection matrix near plane to cull geometry behind the exit portal

propertyDescriptors.name: ForwardAxis
propertyDescriptors.label: Forward axis (outward normal)
propertyDescriptors.description: Local axis perpendicular to the portal face pointing outward into the room

propertyDescriptors.name: IsOpen
propertyDescriptors.label: Is open / active
propertyDescriptors.description: Whether the portal is currently open and rendering its destination feed

eventsFunctions.name: SetCustomResolution
eventsFunctions.description: Set portal _PARAM0_ resolution to _PARAM2_ x _PARAM3_ pixels

eventsFunctions.name: IsLinked
eventsFunctions.fullName: Check if portal is linked to another portal
eventsFunctions.description: Portal _PARAM0_ is linked to a destination portal

behaviors.name: PortalTraversable3D
behaviors.description: Allows characters and physics objects to pass seamlessly through 3D portals with momentum redirection.

propertyDescriptors.name: Enabled
propertyDescriptors.label: Traversable enabled
propertyDescriptors.description: Whether this object can physically teleport through active portals

propertyDescriptors.name: TeleportCooldown
propertyDescriptors.label: Teleport cooldown (seconds)
propertyDescriptors.description: Minimum delay between consecutive teleports to prevent ping-pong oscillation

propertyDescriptors.name: RedirectVelocity
propertyDescriptors.label: Redirect velocity & momentum
propertyDescriptors.description: Rotates linear velocity vectors to match exit portal orientation while preserving speed

propertyDescriptors.name: RedirectCamera
propertyDescriptors.label: Redirect camera / object rotation
propertyDescriptors.description: Rotates object and camera yaw/pitch to face outwards from destination portal

propertyDescriptors.name: ExitOffset
propertyDescriptors.label: Exit normal offset distance
propertyDescriptors.description: Units to nudge object forward along destination portal normal upon emergence

eventsFunctions.name: SetTeleportCooldown
eventsFunctions.description: Set teleport cooldown for _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ seconds

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Distance to push entity along exit normal

eventsFunctions.name: JustTeleported
eventsFunctions.fullName: Check if entity just teleported this frame

eventsFunctions.name: IsEnabled
eventsFunctions.fullName: Check if portal traversal is enabled

eventsFunctions.name: TeleportObjectThrough
eventsFunctions.fullName: Manually teleport an object through portals
